description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/artist-3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Instructions" name="Project instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="You" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instructions" name="Project instructions" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Event_ArtistInstructions" messageRef="Message_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ArtistChanges" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_CustomerStart" name="Want a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct the artist to create a project" messageRef="Message_Instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive the STL model" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_ChangesToResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewResult" name="Review the result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?" default="Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Satisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell the artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_ChangesToResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Satisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Color in stock?" default="Flow_ColorNotInStock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorNotInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckColorAmount" name="Check how much color is left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorAmountChecked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100Grams" name="Under 100 grams?" default="Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorAmountChecked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorUnder100Grams</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Put color on the shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorUnder100Grams</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShoppingListToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorNotInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PlasticAvailable" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AvailabilityToReady</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">plasticAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorReady" name="Plastic ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShoppingListToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AvailabilityToReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorReadyToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and generate G-code">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorReadyToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on the printer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HeatBed" name="Heat the bed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeatBedToExtruder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HeatExtruder" name="Heat the extruder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HeatBedToExtruder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeatingToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from the artist's STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GcodeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer preparation and G-code complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HeatingToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GcodeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToPrint</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToPrint</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrintToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CustomerEnd" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrintToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusStart" name="Printer sends status" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusStartToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusEnd" name="Status received">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusStartToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusStartToEnd" sourceRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusEnd"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Event_CustomerStart" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Task_ReviewResult" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Satisfied" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NotSatisfied" name="Changes needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ChangesToResult" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorInStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckColorAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorNotInStock" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAmountChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckColorAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100Grams"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorUnder100Grams" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100Grams" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAtLeast100Grams" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100Grams" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingListToReady" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAvailability" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Event_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AvailabilityToReady" sourceRef="Event_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorReadyToSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorReady" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrinterPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOnToHeatBed" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatBed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatBedToExtruder" sourceRef="Task_HeatBed" targetRef="Task_HeatExtruder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatExtruder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGenerateGcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GcodeToJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPrint" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrintToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="Event_CustomerEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistInstructions" name="Receive project instructions">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_Instructions"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send the STL model" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ArtistEnd" name="STL model sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_05</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistChanges" name="Receive requested changes">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_Changes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseProject" name="Revise the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_Changes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Artist_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ArtistRevisionEnd" name="Revised STL model sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Artist_05</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Event_ArtistInstructions" targetRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_Changes" sourceRef="Event_ArtistChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviseProject" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Event_ArtistEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
